title: Webhook deliveries failing with 502 or timeouts
body: Webhook deliveries are retried when your endpoint returns a non-2xx status or does not answer within 10 seconds. A 502 or 504 recorded on our side usually means a proxy or load balancer in front of your endpoint rejected the request or the handler took too long. Return 200 immediately and process the event asynchronously. Deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for 24 hours; after that the endpoint is disabled and must be re-enabled under Settings > Webhooks.
answer: Webhook deliveries fail when your endpoint returns a non-2xx status or takes longer than 10 seconds. A 502 usually comes from a proxy or load balancer in front of your endpoint. Return 200 right away and process the event in the background; failed deliveries are retried for 24 hours, after which you can re-enable the endpoint under Settings > Webhooks and replay missed events.

title: Verifying webhook signatures
body: Every webhook includes a Relay-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using your endpoint signing secret. Signature checks fail when the body is parsed and re-serialized before verification or when an old secret is used after rotation.
answer: Signature checks fail when the body is re-serialized before verification or an old secret is used. Verify the HMAC-SHA256 against the raw request body with the current signing secret shown under Settings > Webhooks.

title: API rate limits and 429 responses
body: The API allows 100 requests per second per key on standard plans and 500 on enterprise plans. Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Use exponential backoff and batch endpoints for bulk work.
answer: The API returns 429 when a key exceeds its rate limit (100 requests/second on standard, 500 on enterprise). Honour the Retry-After header, back off exponentially, and use the batch endpoints for bulk work.

title: 401 unauthorized after rotating API keys
body: When an API key is rotated, the old key stops working after the grace period you selected (immediately, 1 hour or 24 hours). Requests with a revoked key return 401 invalid_api_key. Update every service that uses the key, including CI secrets.
answer: A 401 invalid_api_key after rotation means the old key's grace period ended. Update every service and CI secret to the new key from Settings > API keys; you can create a second key to roll over without downtime.

title: Setting up SAML single sign-on
body: SSO is available on business and enterprise plans. Add the identity provider metadata URL under Settings > Security > SSO, map the email attribute, and test with one user before enforcing SSO for everyone. Login errors saying 'audience mismatch' mean the entity ID in your identity provider does not match the one shown in settings.
answer: To set up SAML SSO, add your identity provider's metadata URL under Settings > Security > SSO, map the email attribute, and test with one user before enforcing it. An 'audience mismatch' error means the entity ID in your identity provider doesn't match the one shown in settings.

title: Locked out after losing a two-factor device
body: Users who lose their 2FA device can sign in with one of the backup codes generated at enrollment. Workspace admins can reset 2FA for a member from Members > Security. Support cannot disable 2FA without verifying identity through an admin.
answer: Use one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-factor login. If you don't have them, ask a workspace admin to reset 2FA for you from Members > Security; support can't remove 2FA without an admin verifying your identity.

title: Password reset emails not arriving
body: Password reset emails are sent from no-reply and expire after 30 minutes. If they do not arrive, check spam folders and allowlist the sender domain. Accounts that sign in through SSO cannot reset a password here and must use their identity provider.
answer: Reset emails expire after 30 minutes and are often caught by spam filters, so check spam and allowlist our sender domain. If your workspace uses SSO, reset the password with your identity provider instead.

title: CSV exports timing out or arriving empty
body: Exports larger than 1 million rows run as background jobs and are emailed as a download link when ready. Very wide date ranges can time out in the browser; narrow the range or use the scheduled export option. Empty files usually mean the filters exclude all rows.
answer: Large CSV exports run in the background and arrive by email as a download link. If an export times out, narrow the date range or use a scheduled export; an empty file usually means the filters exclude every row.

title: Data sync delays between workspaces
body: Sync jobs run every 15 minutes. A sync that has not completed in over an hour is usually blocked by an expired integration token. Reconnect the integration under Settings > Integrations to refresh the token and trigger a manual sync.
answer: Sync runs every 15 minutes. If it's been stuck for over an hour, the integration token has usually expired: reconnect the integration under Settings > Integrations and start a manual sync.

title: Downloading invoices and updating the payment card
body: Invoices are available under Billing > Invoices as PDF. Workspace owners can update the payment card under Billing > Payment method. Failed card payments are retried three times over seven days.
answer: Invoices are under Billing > Invoices as PDFs. Owners can change the card under Billing > Payment method; failed payments are retried three times over seven days.

title: Refund policy
body: Refunds are reviewed by the billing team. Support agents cannot issue refunds or credits directly. Annual plans can be refunded pro rata within 30 days of renewal. Duplicate charges are always refunded after verification.
answer: Refunds are handled by our billing team, who review each request. Annual plans can be refunded pro rata within 30 days of renewal, and duplicate charges are refunded once verified.

title: Changing plans and seat counts
body: Owners can upgrade or downgrade under Billing > Plan. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period. Seats can be added at any time; removed seats are credited at renewal.
answer: Owners can change plans under Billing > Plan. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the end of the current period. You can add seats any time, and removed seats are credited at renewal.

title: Inviting teammates and invite links expiring
body: Invites are sent by email and expire after 7 days. Admins can resend an invite from Members > Pending. Invites fail for addresses outside the allowed domains when domain restrictions are on.
answer: Invites expire after 7 days; an admin can resend one from Members > Pending. If domain restrictions are on, the address must belong to an allowed domain.

title: Dashboard loading slowly
body: Dashboards with many widgets over long date ranges can take several seconds to load. Reduce the date range, split large dashboards, or enable cached snapshots under the dashboard settings menu.
answer: Large dashboards over long date ranges load slowly. Shorten the date range, split the dashboard, or turn on cached snapshots from the dashboard's settings menu.

title: Deleting an account and data retention
body: Workspace owners can delete a workspace under Settings > Danger zone. Data is removed within 30 days, and backups expire after a further 30 days. Deletion cannot be undone.
answer: Owners can delete a workspace under Settings > Danger zone. Data is removed within 30 days and backups expire 30 days after that; deletion can't be undone.
